content.short: Pentacle helps you explore protocols with a focus on security, reputation, and relationships.
content.description: Pentacle delivers real-time data across yield opportunities, audits, risk management, integrations, governance, treasuries, team members, jobs, grants and bounties. It lets you focus tightly on a single project or widen the view to compare across projects, and it maps relationships among projects, people, skill levels and topics to reveal connections. The tool also supports favorites lists, private notes and browsing history, helping you organize information with verified links and practical learning resources for crypto research.
content.meta: Pentacle is an infrastructure platform. Discover Pentacle and other Infrastructure Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
